content:
People.ai, now known as Backstory, an enterprise Revenue Intelligence and Revenue Operations platform. It is made to help companies improve their sales, productivity, forecasting accuracy, and pipeline visibility. The platform uses AI to automatically capture structure and analyse customer engagement. Especially across communication channels that remove the need for manual CRM updates. 

Backstory serves as an intelligent data layer. In turn, it helps companies to make a complete picture of customer relationships.

How does Backstory work?

Backstory works as a background intelligence engine. It captures business interactions, cleans and fills the data. 

  • Automated Activity Capture- Backstory monitors emails, meetings, calls, and other customer interactions. 
  • CRM Data Enrichment- It improves CRM records by adding missing customer details.
  • Relationship Intelligence- The platform understands relationships between contacts, stakeholders, and accounts.
  • Revenue Analytics- Backstory gives insight into pipeline health, sales performance, forecasting accuracy, etc. 
  • AI-Powered Decision Support- It uses AI to find insights, predict outcomes, and identify risks. At the same time, it recommends the next best actions for sales and revenue. 

Core Capabilities

CRM Data Enrichment

It automatically enriches CRM records by finding contacts, stakeholders, and relationship data. It ensures account details remain accurate and complete. 

Opportunity and Deal Intelligence

The platform monitors active opportunities and identifies engagement gaps, stalled deals, and missing stakeholders that could affect the deal.

Relationship Intelligence

Backstory maps buyer committees and tracks stakeholder engagement. This helps sales teams to understand account dynamics across complex enterprise opportunities. 

Revenue Forecasting

It uses customer engagement signals and historical activity patterns to give more objective forecasting. Also, it gives pipeline analysis.

What makes Backstory different?

  • Backstory works as a modern revenue intelligence data layer.
  • It removes manual CRM updates. This is done using automated activity capture and enrichment.
  • Backstory makes visual buying committee maps. It also makes relationship intelligence insights. 
  • It integrates directly with enterprise AI tools through Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Key Services

  • Automated Data Capture Services- Backstory gathers and syncs communication data. 
  • Automated Data Capture Services- It captures and syncs communication data from email platforms, calendars, collaboration tools, video meetings, etc. 
  • CRM Automation and Data Management- The platform makes missing contacts, updates relationship records, and maintains CRM hygiene.

Advanced Capabilities

  • Opportunity Graph Intelligence- Backstory maps relationships, interactions, stakeholders, and opportunities. It is added into a connected intelligence framework. This gives context across the entire customer journey. 
  • Intelligent Entity Resolution- It uses AI-driven matching algorithms to connect divided customer data in different communication channels.  
  • Buying Committee Mapping - The platform automatically identifies decision-makers, Influencers, champions, and stakeholders. All of it is involved in enterprise buying processes.
  • Enterprise AI Integration- It streams structured revenue Intelligence into AI platforms. It can use Claude, Microsoft, Copilot, and custom enterprise AI assistants.

Who should use Backstory?

  • Large Enterprises
    1. Who manage large scale companies with complex revenue operations. 
    2. Want better forecasting accuracy and pipeline visibility. 
  • Revenue Operations Teams
    1. Who wants to maintain CRM hygiene and data consistency 
    2. Standardise revenue platforms in different departments. 
  • Sales Leadership Teams
    1. Who wants to improve forecast accuracy?

Best-Fit Industries

  • Enterprise Software and SaaS
  • Cybersecurity 
  • Telecommunications 
  • Manufacturing 
  • Financial Services

Key Use Cases

  • Buying Committee Mapping helps account teams identify decision-makers, influencers, and relationship gaps in target accounts. 
  • Pipeline Visibility - The platform provides a more accurate view of deal progression and customer engagement for active opportunities. 
  • Revenue Forecasting- Backstory uses activity-based signals and historical patterns to improve forecast reliability. 
  • Relationship intelligence- It monitors stakeholder engagement and highlights account expansion opportunities.

Pros 

  • Removes manual CRM data entry 
  • Strong relationship intelligence capabilities 
  • Excellent account mapping and buying committee visibility
  • Improves CRM data quality and forecasting accuracy

Considerations 

  • Best suited for mid-market and enterprise organisations
  • Needs strong CRM foundations for better effectiveness

Top Alternatives

  • MarketJoy- Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • Clari- It is a strong forecasting and revenue operations platform. 
  • BoostUp- It combines forecasting, revenue intelligence and pipeline inspection. 
  • Revenue.io provides real-time sales guidance, call intelligence, and outbound sales execution.

Conclusion

People.ai, now Backstory, has evolved into a sophisticated Revenue Intelligence platform. It helps companies transform fragmented customer interactions into structured business intelligence. In fact, Backstory helps companies to build a more accurate and scalable revenue operation.

Are you looking to remove manual CRM work and get more value from your revenue data? Backstory can help create a more connected, intelligent, and predictable revenue engine.
